big-news.text: King Haakon gave his first speech as king last night at the annual dinner for Storting members at the Palace, mixing jokes with a serious message. It was a big gala night for Crown Princess Ingrid Alexandra too.
The Oil Fund returned −0.5% in Q3, and its value fell by NOK 670 billion over the quarter.
A man died in a house fire in Haugesund overnight, and the other residents were evacuated.

whats-changing.text: This year's flu vaccines are delayed in several places, so check with your pharmacy before you go.

oslo.text: There are new details on the T-bane shutdown Nov 19–22. Of 101 stations, 63 will close, lines 4 and 5 shut completely, and trams will replace the T-bane between Majorstuen and Jernbanetorget. It's also the first of seven closures running into 2027.
Heavy rain has pushed back this weekend's asphalt work at the Fornebu junction, so there should be less traffic out of Oslo than expected.

be-aware.text: It's a wet weekend at about 9–10°C, with rain on Saturday and around 16–17 mm on Sunday, though there are no warnings.

fun-and-free.text: Top pick: Oslo Skaperfestival is a free maker festival at Deichman Bjørvika on Saturday and Sunday from 11:00, which makes it perfect for the rain.
Odysseas Kousoulas Sharp plays a free sing-along pub set at Amundsen Bryggeri tonight at 22:00.
